purpose: Verified contract for explaining material conditions that would trigger reassessment of an approved property answer.
dependency_rule: Only dependencies actually supporting the approved answer are treated as material triggers.
trigger_rule: A trigger requires reassessment; it does not predict the result of reassessment.
evidence_rule: New evidence changes an answer only if its material effect is established.
legal_rule: Legal-source changes are evaluated against the specific legal dependencies of the answer.
historical_rule: Historical answers are reassessed against changes relevant to their historical scope and legal version.
procedure_rule: Procedure/deadline changes may affect next steps without necessarily changing the substantive legal conclusion.
uncertainty_rule: The future outcome of reassessment remains open unless already established.
verification_boundary: The engine identifies reassessment triggers; it does not predict future facts, legal outcomes or source changes.
